title: Spinach and Ricotta Cannelloni
blurb: Pasta tubes filled with creamy ricotta and spinach, baked in a simple white sauce until golden.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Wilt the spinach in a large pan over medium heat until collapsed, then squeeze out excess water and chop roughly.
Mix the ricotta with the chopped spinach, half the Parmesan, a pinch of nutmeg, and salt and pepper to taste.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour and cook for one minute, then gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Simmer for five minutes until thickened, then season with salt and pepper.
Spoon the ricotta mixture into the cannelloni tubes and arrange them in a single layer in a baking dish.
Pour the white sauce over the filled pasta, covering it completely, then scatter the remaining Parmesan on top.
Bake for 35 minutes until the top is golden and the pasta is tender when pierced with a knife.
